title: Si Kelabu Lambat Lagi
genre: poetic piano chamber pop (Sal Priadi lane)
mood: wry, warm, a lump in the throat held back by a joke
subject: a retired postman who keeps racing pigeons on his flat's rooftop and waits every Sunday for the slowest bird, a grey one, long after the others are home
caption: Poetic piano chamber pop in the style of 2024-2026 Indonesian singer-songwriter Sal Priadi. An upright piano with soft felt playing slow broken chords; a string quartet breathing long notes behind the voice and rising in the chorus; a warm upright bass; a brushed snare entering in the second verse; a single clarinet line answering the vocal. Warm and close, felt piano in the centre, strings behind, a natural hall tail. Male voice, an intimate theatrical tenor, half-speaking the verses and opening up in the chorus. 84 BPM, E-flat major. Wry and warm, a lump in the throat held back by a joke. No trap beat, no autotune, no power-ballad drums, no electric guitar solo, no EDM pads.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, solo cello]

[Verse 1]
Pukul empat semua dah balik
Yang putih, yang tompok, yang belang leher
Masuk sangkar, makan jagung, tidur awal
Tinggal satu tak sampai lagi

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku duduk atas tong air
Jam tangan lama, kopi dah sejuk

[Chorus]
Si Kelabu, lambat lagi
Singgah mana pula kali ini
Tak menang pun tak apa
Asalkan kau ingat jalan balik

[Verse 2]
Dulu aku hantar surat satu taman
Tak pernah sekali salah rumah
Kau ni pula, burung pos
Paling sesat dalam dunia

[Pre-Chorus]
Matahari dah jatuh atas kilang
Jiran panggil, Pak Din, masuklah

[Chorus]
Si Kelabu, lambat lagi
Tu dia, atas antena TV
Tak menang pun tak apa
Kau balik juga, macam aku dulu

[Outro - piano alone]
Ahad depan kita cuba lagi
